purpose: Licences a person read from a manufacturer's own package or page, for boards whose terms are not in a GitHub repository. read_licenses.py --statements applies one only when the source still has the reviewed SHA-256 and every quote is still in it. 'fields' and 'scope' limit a statement to the files it covers. 'embedded' names a file a KiCad design embeds in itself, such as its drawing frame, and the quotes are checked in that file.

statements.covers: The seven KiCad schematic sheets of Seeed's SCH&PCB package, linked from the official wiki page: the root sheet embeds Seeed's drawing frame Seeed_SCH_Open_Source.kicad_wks, which prints "CC BY-SA 4.0" in the title block of every sheet (as the schematic PDF in the repository, 4_Hardware/Seeed_Studio_XIAO_Debug_Mate_V1.0_SCH_20250926.pdf, shows on all seven pages). The board layout (.kicad_pcb) carries no title block or licence text, and the housing STEP and 3MF files carry none, so they are not covered.
